definitions.ask: Should Ctrl+D/U scroll the inspector's NSScrollView from the panel controller instead of SwiftUI?

choices.label: Yes; synchronous AppKit scroll, passes on the Mac, reverses the original SwiftUI-only design
No; keep SwiftUI, fix only lookup and diagnostics; CI likely stays red another round

definitions.why: Removes the CI-only SwiftUI dependency instead of waiting on another red CI round
